carpet.rule.autoMending.name: Automatic Mending
carpet.rule.autoMending.desc: Automatically spends the player's existing XP to repair damaged items enchanted with Mending, once per second
carpet.rule.voidWarehouse.name: Void Warehouse
carpet.rule.voidWarehouse.desc: A crafting table renamed via anvil becomes a server-wide shared warehouse
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseRestock.name: Void Warehouse Restock
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseRestock.desc: Lets a printer that ran out of blocks while building take a full stack straight from the Void Warehouse. Warning: while enabled, any player with a compatible printer can draw from the shared stock
